name: WPGeared Better Export
author: WPGeared

sections.description:
WPGeared Better Export helps you create focused, predictable exports instead of downloading everything and sorting it out later. Filter content by type, status, date, author, category, tag, and item limit, then export posts and pages as WordPress WXR or export public content types as CSV.

New in 1.3.0: Preview Before You Export

Version 1.3.0 adds an export preview to both the WXR and Data Export tabs. Click Preview Export to review the result before starting the download.

  • See the total number of items matching your filters.
  • See how many items will actually be exported after applying an item limit.
  • Confirm the active content type, statuses, dates, author, taxonomies, fields, and output settings.
  • Inspect up to five sample items using the values prepared for the export.
  • Review an estimated output size before downloading.
  • Change a setting and the previous preview is cleared automatically, preventing stale results from being mistaken for the current selection.

Preview and download use the same validated filters and CSV value preparation, helping the preview accurately represent the export you are about to create. The size is an estimate based on the sample and may vary from the final file.

Highlights

  • Preview matching content, selected settings, sample rows, and estimated size before exporting.
  • Export straight to WXR for migrations or CSV for spreadsheets, reporting, and BI tools.
  • Targeted filtering by date range, post status, taxonomy, author, post type, and limits.
  • Select exactly which CSV columns to include, including relative URLs and featured images.
  • Built-in quick presets (Last Month, This Year, etc.) keep repetitive workflows fast.
  • Familiar WordPress-style interface so teams can adopt it without training.

Key Features

  • Export Preview: Check matching and effective counts, active settings, sample rows, and estimated size before downloading
  • Dual Export Formats: Export posts and pages as WXR for migration, or export public content types as CSV for analysis
  • Advanced Filtering: Filter by date range, post status, categories, tags, author, content type, and item limit
  • Selective Field Export: Choose from 18 CSV fields so the file contains only the data you need
  • Featured Images: Include featured-image attachment data in WXR or export the image URL as a CSV field
  • Quick Date Presets: Apply common WXR date ranges such as Last Month, This Month, and This Year
  • Custom Filenames: Choose the downloaded CSV filename
  • Browser Table: Display selected data in the browser when a downloadable CSV is not required

WXR Export

Export filtered posts or pages in WordPress WXR format for migration between WordPress sites. Before downloading, preview the matching count, selected options, sample content, and estimated size. WXR can include:
* Full post/page content
* Categories and tags
* Comments
* Custom fields
* Featured images with attachment data
* Author information

CSV Export

Export posts, pages, and public custom post types as CSV for data analysis, reporting, or external use. Preview the selected columns and sample values first. Choose from 18 fields including:
* Post ID, Title, Slug, URL
* Content and Excerpt
* Categories and Category URLs
* Tags and Tag URLs
* Author information
* Published and Modified dates
* Status and Post Type
* Comment count
* Featured Image URL

Advanced Filtering

  • Date Range: Filter by specific date ranges with date pickers
  • Quick Presets: Use preset ranges (Last Month, This Year, etc.)
  • Post Status: Filter by Published, Draft, Pending, Scheduled, Private, or Trashed
  • Categories & Tags: Multi-select dropdowns for easy selection
  • Author: Filter by specific authors
  • Content Limits: Set maximum number of items to export

Perfect For

  • Migrating specific content between WordPress sites
  • Creating backups of filtered content
  • Exporting data for analysis in Excel or other tools
  • Exporting content by date range or category
  • Testing exports before full site migration

Why WPGeared Better Export?

  • Migration specialists move only the content they need, avoiding bloated XML files.
  • Content teams track editorial output with CSV datasets filtered by author or taxonomy.
  • Data analysts receive clean, ready-to-query exports for Excel, Google Sheets, or BI tools.
  • Agencies streamline QA by exporting smaller test batches before large moves.

Need help or have a feature request? Open a support topic on WordPress.org or visit https://wpgeared.com for priority assistance.
sections.installation:
1. In Plugins → Add New, search for “WPGeared Better Export” and click Install Now (or upload the ZIP manually).
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open Tools → Export Posts to access the WXR and Data Export tabs.
  4. Choose your content, filters, fields, and export options.
  5. Click Preview Export to verify the count, active settings, sample rows, and estimated size.
  6. When the preview looks correct, click the export button to download or display the result.
sections.faq:
How do I export posts?

Go to Tools → Export Posts, select your filters, and click “Export Posts (WXR Format)” or use the Data Export tab for CSV format.

Can I export pages or CPTs?

Yes. The WXR tab exports posts or pages for WordPress migration. The Data Export tab exports posts, pages, individual public custom post types, or an “All Types” selection that combines them.

Will featured images be included?

Yes, when you enable “Include Featured Images” in WXR export, all attachment data is included so images download during import. CSV exports can include the Featured Image URL column.

What format should I use?

  • Use WXR for migrating content to another WordPress site.
  • Use CSV for data analysis, reporting, or external use.

How many columns can I export in CSV?

You can choose from 18 fields, including ID, title, URL, taxonomies, author data, dates, status, post type, comment count, and featured image URL. Only the selected columns are included.

Can I check an export before downloading it?

Yes. Click Preview Export to see how many items match, how many will be exported after applying the limit, the active settings, up to five sample rows, and an estimated output size. Changing any export setting clears the previous preview so stale results are not shown.

How do I export very large datasets safely?

Start with Preview Export to check the matching count and estimated size. For a large result, narrow the date range or use the item limit to create smaller exports, such as 500 items at a time. Very large sites may still be subject to their server’s PHP memory and execution-time limits.

Do I need special permissions?

Anyone with the standard WordPress export capability (Editors and Administrators by default) can run exports. Use a role manager plugin if you need to grant that capability to custom roles.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added Preview Export to both the WXR and Data Export tabs.
  • Added total matching counts and effective export counts after item limits are applied.
  • Added summaries of the active content, status, date, author, taxonomy, field, and output settings.
  • Added up to five sample items using the same prepared values as the export.
  • Added estimated WXR, CSV, and browser-table output sizes.
  • Automatically clears stale previews and cancels an in-progress preview when settings change.
  • Unified preview and download query validation so both paths apply the same filters.
  • Protected preview requests with WordPress nonces and the standard export capability.

1.2.4

  • Added highlights section and refreshed readme copy for better Plugin Directory visibility.
  • Clarified installation and FAQ instructions for WXR/CSV workflows.
  • Prepared structure for upcoming banner, icon, and screenshot assets.

1.2.3

  • Fixed performance issue – added version parameter to wp_register_style() for proper cache busting

1.2.2

  • Fixed coding standards errors for WordPress core hook usage
  • Added phpcs:ignore comments for the_title_rss filter (WordPress core hook)

1.2.1

  • Updated author information to WPGeared
  • Updated author URI to https://wpgeared.com
  • Updated contributors to match WordPress.org username

1.2.0

  • Fixed deprecated utf8_encode() function – replaced with mb_convert_encoding() for PHP 8.2+ compatibility
  • Improved CSS/JS enqueuing – now using wp_add_inline_style() and wp_add_inline_script() following WordPress best practices
  • Enhanced encoding detection for better character handling in exports

1.1.0

  • Added tabbed interface with WXR and Data Export tabs
  • Added CSV export functionality with 18+ field options
  • Added support for custom post types
  • Improved UI with Better Search Replace style design
  • Added multi-select dropdowns for categories and tags
  • Added attachment export for featured images
  • Fixed PHP 8+ compatibility issues
  • Improved security with proper escaping functions
  • Fixed UTC timestamp generation

1.1.7

  • Fixed InputNotSanitized warnings using phpcs:disable/phpcs:enable blocks
  • Improved input sanitization handling for Plugin Repo check

1.1.6

  • Fixed MissingUnslash warnings by unslashing directly in assignment
  • Improved phpcs:ignore comment placement

1.1.5

  • Fixed remaining Plugin Repo input sanitization warnings
  • Added phpcs:ignore comments for proper input handling flow

1.1.4

  • Fixed array input sanitization warnings for Plugin Repo check
  • Improved $_POST array handling with proper isset() checks

1.1.3

  • Fixed remaining Plugin Repo coding standards issues
  • Fixed array input sanitization warnings
  • Improved phpcs:disable/phpcs:enable block usage

1.1.2

  • Fixed Plugin Repo coding standards compliance
  • Improved phpcs:ignore comment formatting
  • Fixed input sanitization warnings

1.1.1

  • Fixed WordPress coding standards compliance issues
  • Improved security with proper input sanitization
  • Fixed escaping issues for better security

1.1.0

  • Major update with CSV export, improved UI, and enhanced features
  • Added Data Export tab with advanced filtering
  • Improved UI design similar to Better Search Replace
  • Added multi-select dropdowns for categories and tags
  • Enhanced featured image export in WXR format

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WXR export functionality
  • Basic filtering options
